applies_to: spec/lld/LLD-01..LLD-12 packets and global LLD registries
purpose: Fail closed before ai_implementation_ready when the machine-addressable design contains missing paths, unresolved contracts, ambiguous ownership or cross-file drift that would force an implementation AI to invent behavior.
pass_rule: PASS requires zero BLOCKER or HIGH findings. MEDIUM/LOW findings require explicit accepted exception records before owner acceptance.

checks.name: packet_manifest_matches_filesystem
prove: every packet-index normative path exists
every normative leaf under governed directories is indexed or explicitly nonnormative
no duplicate manifest path

checks.name: mandatory_packet_properties
prove: all V2 mandatory packet-index properties exist
ai_implementation_ready and owner_accepted are booleans
review_ready never implies ai_implementation_ready

checks.name: route_resolution
prove: every route references an existing command/query/internal handler
all routes use canonical /api/v1 prefix
every route resolves request_type,response_type,max_request_bytes,auth_policy,error_codes

checks.name: command_contract_resolution
prove: every authoritative command resolves exact request/response types
no unbound placeholder inputs remain
every mutation resolves transaction boundary, revision effects, audit action and test IDs

checks.name: audit_registry_closure
prove: every authoritative mutation references an existing action_type/version
referenced payload schema/version exists
sensitivity/target/result-ref policy exists

checks.name: setting_registry_closure
prove: every packet-owned semantic setting referenced by route/service is registered
definition includes key/owner/version/default/validator/equality/storage/bounds/value contract

checks.name: job_registry_closure
prove: every enqueued/handled durable job type is registered
payload/checkpoint/retry/crash/cancellation/sensitivity/coalescing policies exist
unknown job versions fail closed

checks.name: cross_packet_interface_single_provider
prove: every consumed cross-packet interface has exactly one declared provider
consumer/provider method signatures and versioned types match exactly
shared-UoW ownership semantics match

checks.name: migration_allocation_closure
prove: every owned table/index/trigger is allocated to exactly one global migration
migration dependencies are ordered
no duplicate/ad-hoc sequence
checks.automation: schema object to migration manifest reconciliation

checks.name: requirement_normative_coverage
prove: every governing requirement ID in packet index maps to at least one normative leaf and test
supporting requirements do not silently become governing authority

checks.name: command_test_traceability
prove: every mutation has success coverage
stateful mutation has stale/precondition coverage
idempotent mutation has replay/no-change coverage when applicable
failure-injection coverage exists for multi-row/cross-domain/file/job atomicity

checks.name: schema_fk_index_guard_closure
prove: all authoritative tables use required STRICT policy
every child FK has usable leading-prefix index or accepted measured exception
append-only/projection pointer guards referenced by design exist and are migration-allocated

checks.name: query_index_cursor_closure
prove: every paged query uses deterministic total ordering
CURSOR_V1 exact key tuple and null order resolve
performance-critical query declares required supporting index

checks.name: state_machine_transition_closure
prove: commands/events referenced by owned state machines appear in transition matrices
forbidden transitions/errors are explicit
correction/reversal preserves immutable prior evidence

checks.name: implementation_module_map_closure
prove: every command/query/repository/service/route/job maps to source-module destination
dependency direction obeys packet ownership
no two packets claim same authoritative module responsibility

checks.name: artifact_contract_closure
prove: every generated artifact has versioned format contract
writer and verifier reference same artifact contract
temporary/finalization/collision behavior is explicit

checks.name: unresolved_design_placeholder_scan
checks.rule: Potential matches are reviewed contextually; an unresolved authority/schema/interface placeholder inside packet scope blocks ai_implementation_ready.

checks.name: leaf_granularity_budget
prove: normative leaves <=12000 UTF-8 bytes unless explicit accepted granularity_exception
omnibus files are split when independent commands/tables/queries can be implemented separately

checks.name: command_envelope_idempotency_consistency
prove: all mutating commands use COMMAND_ENVELOPE_V1
request hash inclusion/exclusion contract is exact
replay requires command_id+command_type+request_hash equality

checks.name: error_catalogue_closure
prove: every declared command/query/route failure resolves stable error code
no raw persistence/framework exception is machine contract
recoverability/safe next action exists where globally required

checks.name: revision_policy_closure
prove: every mutable authoritative/projection entity has revision ownership
every command declares exact revision increments/nonincrements
NO_CHANGE never increments revisions

checks.name: bounds_closure
prove: all text/JSON/list/page/file/request-size inputs resolve explicit bounds
no operator-controlled unbounded collection is materialized

required_exception_record.rule: Exceptions cannot waive BLOCKER findings for ai_implementation_ready; HIGH exceptions require explicit project-owner acceptance and compensating evidence.

retrofit_policy.LLD-01..LLD-07: retain review_ready where semantic construction is complete but force ai_implementation_ready=false until V2 gate passes
retrofit_policy.LLD-08..LLD-12: construct natively to V2 rather than retrofitting later
